practices.practice: Always require TLS on the wire and do not disable certificate validation in production when connecting to an Azure DocumentDB Mongo endpoint.

practices.practice: Create a single MongoClient (singleton) per process and reuse it for the application lifetime rather than creating a client per request.

practices.practice: For new Python async code on Azure DocumentDB, prefer PyMongo's AsyncMongoClient (pymongo AsyncMongoClient) rather than Motor because Motor is deprecated for new Python async usage.

practices.practice: In serverless environments initialize the database client outside the handler (module/global scope) and use small pools (e.g., maxPoolSize 3–5, minPoolSize 0) so warm invocations reuse connections and cold starts don't create many idle connections.
Azure DocumentDB's connection string commonly includes retryWrites=false because the service does not support retryable writes; verify driver defaults and set retryWrites accordingly.

When using cosine similarity, L2-normalize (unit-length) embeddings at ingest and store the embedding model name, dimensions and version alongside each vector so you can detect drift and rebuild indexes if the model changes.

practices.practice: Enforce and validate the embedding dimension and numeric type at write time and ensure index `dimensions` matches the model output exactly; rebuild the index if embedding model or dimension changes.

practices.practice: Choose the vector index type by scale: prefer vector-diskann for production large-scale workloads (M30+), HNSW for up to ~50k vectors, and IVF for very small sets; pick similarity (COS/L2/IP) to match your normalization strategy.
practices.prior_belief: Create a vector index on the embedding field with appropriate algorithm and metric (e.g., HNSW with cosine or inner product) so approximate nearest-neighbor queries run efficiently instead of scanning all documents.

practices.practice: Tune vector index build/query parameters (e.g., DiskANN maxDegree and lBuild at index time; lSearch and k at query time) to trade recall vs latency and test with realistic queries.
practices.prior_belief: When creating vector indexes, tune index parameters (e.g., M, efConstruction, efSearch, nlist depending on algorithm) according to the target recall vs latency and test with realistic queries.
